title: Sessionized route mart with robust deduplication and late-arrival handling
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a curated, sessionized analytics mart that combines route-level invocations, latency, and cost attribution while applying deterministic deduplication and handling late-arriving events. This mart will power Console dashboards (route heatmaps, per-workspace cost-latency trends) and be the canonical source for downstream experiments and billing QA. The goal is a compact daily table (partitioned + clustered) with one row per session-route-tenant-day and lightweight derived aggregates (counts, p50/p95 latency, token cost sums).
acceptance_criteria: Mart exposes one row per (tenant_id, route_id, session_id, event_date) with deterministic primary key and documented schema
Deterministic dedup removes duplicate/duplicate-reordered events for the same invocation using (request_id, invocation_hash) within a 15m ingestion window
Late-arriving events (up to 24h) are merged incrementally without double-counting; backfill strategy documented
Daily partitions and clustering by tenant_id, route_id applied in BigQuery; partition pruning reduces scan costs by >=50% vs raw events for typical Console queries
DBT models include unit tests for nulls, monotonic timestamps, and row-count stability; CI runs snapshot tests and data quality checks
End-to-end dashboard (staging) shows p50/p95 latency and cost-per-invocation aligned with runtime metrics within 3%
Rollout plan executed: canary with 5 high-traffic workspaces for 72h then gradual ramp to all tenants
implementation_notes: Input sources: console_events_v2 (streamed), route_catalog.dim_routes (static), invoice_metadata (cost rates)

Dedupe approach: compute invocation_fingerprint = sha256(concat(request_id, COALESCE(trace_id,''), invocation_payload_hash)) and use ROW_NUMBER() over (invocation_fingerprint, ingestion_window) to keep first occurrence

Sessionization: session_id = concat(tenant_id, '-', route_id, '-', session_start_unix) where session_start is the last event with gap >= 5 minutes (inactivity-based sessionization) computed in ordered window functions
Storage: BigQuery dataset analytics_curated.session_route_mart; partitioned by event_date (DATE) and clustered by tenant_id, route_id, session_id
Materialization: incremental dbt model with MERGE semantics using deduplication key and ingestion watermark; nightly full re-materialize window for last 7 days to capture late arrivals
Retention: keep 90 days of full session rows in the mart, longer retention in raw event store for audit
Cost estimate: expected 2-4 TB/month of processed data during peak; monthly storage ~ $120, query cost savings anticipated from clustered partitions and pre-aggregates
schema_changes: Add fields to mart: session_id, session_start_ts, session_end_ts, invocation_count, total_tokens, total_cost, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, dedupe_marker
Add metadata columns: ingestion_timestamp, source_file_id, event_ingest_offset for lineage
Deprecate consumer queries that read console_events_v2 directly for dashboard routes by updating docs and aliases
testing_plan: Unit tests in dbt: not_null on primary keys, unique on (tenant_id, route_id, session_id, event_date), relationships to dim_routes
Integration: end-to-end run in staging with synthetic replay (script in infra/tests/replay) that injects duplicates, reorders, and late events to validate dedupe and backfill
Monitoring: create data-quality alerts for >2% drop in session counts vs expected baseline and for spikes in deduplicate_rate
Performance: ensure incremental model runs in <30m for nightly window and full re-materialize for last 7 days finishes within 2 hours

2025-03-02 - Data Platform (Sofia): Reviewed partitioning plan — suggested clustering on session_id instead of session_start_ts to optimize session-level queries. Also flagged need for MERGE throttling controls on large tenant backfills.

2025-03-03 - Liam Chen: Addressed Sofia feedback; added MERGE windowing and backoff in dbt macro. Added DBT tests and a staging dashboard to compare runtime metrics against mart aggregates (dashboard link below).

2025-03-04 - Asha Patel: Decided on canary plan — 5 workspaces representing high, medium, low traffic. QA team to run replay tests overnight before canary. Next: schedule infra runbook and rollback steps.
